test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Six persons – Rahul, Ram, Ranjan, Reena, Rohit and Rupali – are sitting around a circular table facing the centre, but not necessarily in the same order. Rupali is sitting second to the right of Ram, who is Reena’s immediate neighbour. Rohit is not an immediate neighbour of Reena. Rahul is an immediate neighbour of both, Rupali and Ram.

Who is sitting second to the left of Ram?
solution:
Given:

Six persons – Rahul, Ram, Ranjan, Reena, Rohit and Rupali – are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Rupali is sitting second to the right of Ram, who is Reena’s immediate neighbour.

Rahul is an immediate neighbour of both, Rupali and Ram.

Rohit is not an immediate neighbour of Reena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/648cc6dffea0612c43d71021558e29bb2da29f97fa8df2f4cdca29e58f79ea04.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b7e92708467f7afde2a26e348ab94d293d646b2c2d97465e06b3b2a7d147daf.png] 

Thus, Ranjan is sitting second to the left of Ram.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
